review_text: Olive Street Food in HSR Layout is one of those rare gems where the name might lead you to expect a basic roadside stall, but the reality is a surprisingly well-managed and aesthetic cafe. Even though the prices are incredibly affordable and easy on the pocket, the setup feels premium and professional. It is a bustling spot that stays crowded for a reason, offering everything from savory chicken dishes to thick shakes without breaking the bank. The efficiency of the place is what really stands out because they have turned ordering into a seamless process. You simply handle the billing at the counter, they assign you a table number, and you can just relax while the staff delivers everything directly to you. While it works for groups of any size, sitting down with a group of four feels like the ideal way to enjoy the space. It has easily earned its reputation as the best quick-bite destination in Bangalore and is a absolute must-visit for anyone looking for quality food that doesn't compromise on the environment or the service.

review_text: I recently visited Olive Street Food Cafe and honestly, it turned out to be a great find in HSR Layout. It’s one of those places that doesn’t look too fancy from the outside, but once you try the food, you understand why it’s so popular among locals.  What I really liked about this place is how budget-friendly it is without compromising on taste or quality. The menu has a wide variety of street-style food like rolls, burgers, sandwiches, and shakes, and everything is made fresh and full of flavor. The parotta rolls and burgers are definitely worth trying—they are filling, well-prepared, and perfect for a quick meal. Their shakes, especially Oreo-based ones, are also quite popular and go really well with the food.  ￼  The ambience is simple, casual, and comfortable—nothing too fancy, but a good place to hang out with friends or grab a quick bite. It does get a bit crowded at times, which clearly shows how much people love this place, but the overall vibe remains lively and welcoming.  ￼  Another big plus is the pricing. You can have a satisfying meal here without spending much, which makes it a go-to spot for regular visits.  ￼  Overall, I had a really good experience here. If you’re in HSR Layout and looking for tasty, affordable street food with a good vibe, Olive Street Food Cafe is definitely worth checking out. I’d surely visit again !

review_text: Olive Street Food in HSR Layout is an excellent place for anyone craving fresh, flavorful, and satisfying street food. The atmosphere is warm and welcoming, perfect for casual get-togethers with friends and family. The food menu offers a wide array of creative wraps, burgers, parotta rolls, sandwiches, and thick shakes—each item bursting with taste and made using fresh ingredients. One of the best things about Olive Street Food is its pricing. Most dishes are very reasonably priced, with many items starting at just ₹39 and nothing on the menu exceeding ₹139, making it one of the most budget-friendly eateries in the area. A hearty meal for two can easily cost under ₹300–₹400, providing excellent value for money without compromising on quality or portion size.  The restaurant prides itself on its clean environment and prompt service, even during busy hours. Olive Street Food is truly a must-visit for anyone looking for a great meal at pocket-friendly prices in HSR Layout.

review_text: I really like their BTM outlet, so I thought of trying this one as well given that it is closer to where I live. Also, this is relatively new, so there is lesser crowd whereas the BTM one is overflowing with people, especially on the weekends.  Overall: It was a good experience and I liked this outlet as well. Do not mind going again once in a while.  Food: The taste is good but the options are very limited for vegetarians. They do have a separate menu for vegetarians and non-vegetarians though, so would not have a difficult time finding your choices. We also tried kitkat shake and oreo shake - tasted fine but do not expect anything extraordinary.  Cost: The best part! Everything is very affordable and the taste is really worth the price. So, if you want to hang out with your friends on low budget, this is your place.  Ambience: Ambience is also good for a hangouts and quick meet-ups. Moreover, it is located in a peaceful area, so there's not a lot of disturbance from outside.  Personally, I would recommend going and trying it once on your own.

review_text: Giving the place 5 stars solely due to their ridiculously cheap prices, you can get rolls and tacos and burgers here for under a hundred rupees which is just unheard of nowadays especially in high cost cities like Bangalore. The waiting time is a bit high because the place is a tad bit crowded especially in the evening thanks to the NIFT campus right out the door.

review_text: Olive Street Food Cafe offered a decent dining experience overall. What stood out the most was the service, courteous, prompt, and attentive, which made the visit pleasant. Also, the ambience was good, a place to hangout with friends.  We ordered the Melted Charcoal and Smoked Charcoal Chicken combo, which came with fried potatoes, salad, corn, and their in-house sauce. The drinks, Banana Peanut and the Cucumber Cooler, were overly sweet for my liking, which took away from their natural flavors. Despite these minor shortcomings, the overall experience was satisfactory. The cafe has potential, and with a few tweaks, it could offer an even better dining experience.

review_text: Olive Street Food Café in HSR Layout is a hidden gem that combines mouthwatering dishes with a cozy and vibrant ambiance. Whether you're a foodie looking to explore unique flavors or just someone seeking a relaxed dining spot, this café has something for everyone.  The menu is diverse and thoughtfully curated, offering a mix of street food classics and café-style delicacies. I tried their loaded sandwiches and pasta, and both dishes were nothing short of perfection. The flavors were spot on, the portions generous, and the presentation appealing.  The café also has an impressive range of beverages. Their cold coffee and fresh juices are a must-try, providing the perfect accompaniment to their delicious food.  What truly sets Olive Street Food Café apart is its welcoming atmosphere. The interiors are chic and comfortable, making it a great spot for catching up with friends, working remotely, or simply enjoying a quiet meal.  The service deserves a special mention – prompt, friendly, and attentive without being intrusive.  Whether you're stopping by for a quick bite or planning a leisurely meal, Olive Street Food Café delivers an experience that keeps you coming back for more. Highly recommended for anyone in HSR Layout!

If you’re looking for tasty, affordable eats, Olive Street Food Cafe is definitely worth a visit!
